label: Forest Research tests geostatistics for plantation monitoring
summary: A Kinleith Forest study combined GIS, soil units, site-index estimates and foliage measurements to explore long-term productivity and nutrition mapping. The authors warned that sparse data prevented confident estimates and recommended structured sampling.

sources.label: Payn, Hill, Höck, Skinner, Thorn and Rijkse, Forest Ecology and Management 122 (1999), 187–196
